Fair Rooken of the Broken Shelf,

'Tis I, Gooken, your brother. It  has been quite some time, hasn't it. Last I remember,  you were Rooken of the Shelf. Until that accident regarding your  horse that is. Speaking of which, how is your horse, Bulbasaur? I hope he's been laying off of the premium hay (that's why he is so chunky). Anyways hope to hear from you soon, dear brother.

Regards, 

Gooken of the Broken Chair
